runs.content: Meta press release (Aug 5, deal announced Jul 28): Meta + BlackRock 1GW data center JV in El Paso, TX -> AI-Tech domain -> source-meta-blackrock-el-paso-datacenter-2026-08-05. BlackRock-managed funds own 80%, Meta 20%, ~$14bn total development cost; Meta sole tenant on a 4yr lease (up to 20yr with extensions) plus ~$13bn declining residual value guarantee -- same leased-back + RVG structure as the Hyperion (Louisiana) SPV, but BlackRock is now the majority equity owner rather than a minority debt anchor. Capacity online 2028. Not a Morningstar/Burry source, no stock parsing applicable.
